blocks.packageReason: Package, justified above: Tier C, 1 attr of 1 ability, no closure: Costar (294 attr 0). Library gaps (requests/B03.md): `effect.copy-ally-stat-changes` (set my stages to my ally's and copy its crit boosts), the atom `party.ally-active` (`getAlly()?.isActive(true)`; `party.ally-exists` asks only `getAlly() !== undefined`, which also holds for a fainted or off-field ally) and `party.multi-battle` (`getBattlerCount() > 1`; `party.doubles` reads `battle.double`, which is false in a triple). The single-player L2 battle has no ally, so canApply is false there; the doubles behaviour is proven by test/tests/elite-redux/decomp/B03/chunk4.test.ts. Suspected game bugs, NOT fixed: (1) when the ally carries Dragon Cheer, `pokemon.getTag(CritBoostTag)` returns the FIRST crit-boost tag of the holder (`getTag` with a class matches subclasses), so if I already had Focus Energy the ally's crit stage number is written onto that Focus Energy tag instead of the Dragon Cheer tag; (2) the Dragon Cheer, Focus Energy and Laser Focus tags are only added, never removed, so a holder that has a boost the ally lacks keeps it (stat stages, on the other hand, are overwritten, including with 0).
